offence: Intentionally causing harassment, alarm, distress or humiliation
arrestable: May arrest without warrant only if committed in a police officer's view (PHA s.18). Not a general warrantless-arrest offence if not in view
punishment: Fine not exceeding $5,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 6 months or both (enhanced under s.8)

offence: Harassment, alarm, distress or humiliation
arrestable: May arrest without warrant only if committed in a police officer's view (PHA s.18). Not a general warrantless-arrest offence if not in view
punishment: Fine not exceeding $5,000 (enhanced under s.8)

offence: Fear, provocation or facilitation of violence
arrestable: May arrest without warrant only if committed in a police officer's view (PHA s.18). Not a general warrantless-arrest offence if not in view
punishment: Fine not exceeding $5,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 12 months or both

offence: Offences in relation to public servant or public service worker
arrestable: May arrest without warrant only if committed in a police officer's view (PHA s.18). Not a general warrantless-arrest offence if not in view
punishment: Fine not exceeding $5,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 12 months or both

offence: Unlawful stalking
arrestable: May arrest without warrant only if committed in a police officer's view (PHA s.18). Not a general warrantless-arrest offence if not in view
punishment: Fine not exceeding $5,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 12 months or both (enhanced for subsequent)

offence: Burning material or discharging firearm / missile in or near public road
arrestable: May arrest without warrant only if committed in a police officer's view (MOA s.40). Not a general warrantless-arrest offence if not in view
punishment: Fine not exceeding $1,000

offence: Nuisances (defacing property, spitting, ferocious dog at large, etc.)
arrestable: May arrest without warrant only if committed in a police officer's view (MOA s.40). Not a general warrantless-arrest offence if not in view
punishment: Typically fine (see Act)

offence: Excessive noise
arrestable: May arrest without warrant only if committed in a police officer's view (MOA s.40). Not a general warrantless-arrest offence if not in view
punishment: Fine not exceeding $1,000

offence: Making of harassing or obscene telephone calls to emergency telephone numbers
arrestable: May arrest without warrant only if committed in a police officer's view (MOA s.40). Not a general warrantless-arrest offence if not in view (max 1 year)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $5,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 1 year or both

offence: Communicating false message (transmits or causes to be transmitted a message known to be false or fabricated)
arrestable: May arrest without warrant (max imprisonment 3 years — CPC default for other laws; also MOA s.40 if in view)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $10,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 years or both. Defence if legitimate purpose related to public order, public safety, national security, or prevention/investigation/prosecution of offences

offence: Soliciting in public place
arrestable: May arrest without warrant only if committed in a police officer's view (MOA s.40). Not a general warrantless-arrest offence if not in view
punishment: See Act

offence: Riotous, disorderly or indecent behaviour in public place / near court, police station, place of worship, etc.
arrestable: May arrest without warrant only if committed in a police officer's view (MOA s.40). Not a general warrantless-arrest offence if not in view
punishment: Fine not exceeding $2,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 6 months or both (subsequent: fine up to $5,000 or imprisonment up to 12 months or both)

offence: Wilful trespass on property
arrestable: May arrest without warrant only if committed in a police officer's view (MOA s.40). Not a general warrantless-arrest offence if not in view
punishment: See Act

offence: Loitering in place, vessel, etc., without satisfactory explanation (reputed thief / unable to account for presence)
arrestable: May arrest without warrant (expressly arrestable under s.22(2) — no in-view limit)
punishment: Imprisonment not exceeding 6 months

offence: Rogues and vagabonds (various idle/disorderly conduct)
arrestable: May arrest without warrant only if committed in a police officer's view (MOA s.40). Not a general warrantless-arrest offence if not in view
punishment: Fine not exceeding $2,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 months or both

offence: Appearing nude in public or private place exposed to public view
arrestable: May arrest without warrant only if committed in a police officer's view (MOA s.40). Not a general warrantless-arrest offence if not in view
punishment: Fine not exceeding $2,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 months or both

offence: Fraudulent possession of property
arrestable: May arrest without warrant (CPC s.64(1)(d) — possession of anything reasonably suspected to be stolen or fraudulently obtained; also MOA s.40 if in officer's view)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $3,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 1 year or both

offence: Using corrosive or explosive substance or offensive weapon to cause hurt
arrestable: May arrest without warrant
punishment: Imprisonment for life and caning with not less than 6 strokes

offence: Carrying offensive weapons in public places
arrestable: May arrest without warrant (expressly arrestable under s.6(4))
punishment: Imprisonment not exceeding 3 years and caning with not less than 6 strokes (prohibited weapon under GEWCA: up to 5 years + caning >= 6 strokes)

offence: Offences relating to scheduled weapons
arrestable: May arrest without warrant
punishment: See Act (scheduled weapons — serious penalties including caning)

offence: Unauthorised possession or use of guns, major parts of guns, or gun accessories
arrestable: May arrest without warrant (max >=3 years / serious arms offence)
punishment: Prohibited gun: up to 5 years + fine. Other gun: up to 36 months + fine. See GEWCA s.17

offence: Unauthorised manufacture, etc., of guns, major parts or gun accessories
arrestable: May arrest without warrant
punishment: Same scale as s.11 — see GEWCA s.17

offence: Unauthorised possession of digital blueprints for manufacture of guns (e.g. 3D printing)
arrestable: May arrest without warrant
punishment: See Act (3D-printed / digital gun manufacture)

offence: Unauthorised trade in guns, major parts or gun accessories
arrestable: May arrest without warrant
punishment: See GEWCA s.17

offence: Unauthorised supply or conveyance of guns, major parts or gun accessories
arrestable: May arrest without warrant
punishment: See GEWCA s.17

offence: Penalties for unlicensed regulated activities involving guns (ss.11-16)
arrestable: May arrest without warrant
punishment: Prohibited gun: up to 5 years + fine. Other gun: up to 36 months + fine

offence: Unauthorised possession of explosives or explosive precursors
arrestable: May arrest without warrant
punishment: Prohibited explosive: up to 5 years + fine up to $100,000. Other explosive: up to 36 months + fine up to $50,000. Precursor: up to 24 months + fine up to $50,000

offence: Unauthorised possession of weapons or noxious substances
arrestable: May arrest without warrant
bailable: Not bailable (where max >=3 years) / see CPC
punishment: Prohibited weapon: up to 36 months + fine up to $40,000. Other weapon / noxious substance: up to 24 months + fine up to $20,000

offence: Unlawful conduct of betting operations, gaming or lotteries
arrestable: May arrest without warrant (expressly arrestable under s.18(5))
punishment: Fine not exceeding $500,000 and imprisonment not exceeding 7 years (repeat: fine up to $700,000 and imprisonment up to 10 years)

offence: Betting operation, gaming or lottery outside of approved gambling venue
arrestable: May arrest without warrant
punishment: See Act (similar scale to s.18 for organisers)

offence: Gambling with unlicensed gambling service provider or at unlawful gambling place
arrestable: May arrest without warrant (expressly arrestable under s.20(4))
punishment: Fine not exceeding $10,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 6 months or both

offence: Having financial interest in unlawful gambling service
arrestable: May arrest without warrant
punishment: See Act

offence: Owning or allowing place to be used for unlawful gambling
arrestable: May arrest without warrant
punishment: See Act

offence: Being in an unlawful gambling place
arrestable: May arrest without warrant
punishment: See Act

offence: Prohibited or unapproved gaming machine use
arrestable: May arrest without warrant
bailable: Not bailable (where max >=3 years) / see Act
punishment: See Act

offence: Possession of unlawful gambling instruments
arrestable: May arrest without warrant (expressly arrestable under s.36(4))
punishment: Fine not exceeding $500,000 and imprisonment not exceeding 7 years (repeat higher)

offence: Supply of liquor without a liquor licence
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the person is offending in the officer's view (LCSCA s.30 applies to ANY provision of this Act — overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $20,000; repeat offender: fine not exceeding $20,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 months or both (enhanced up to 1.5x if in a Liquor Control Zone — s.16)

offence: Consumption of liquor in a public place during a prescribed no-public drinking period
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the person is offending in the officer's view (LCSCA s.30 applies to ANY provision of this Act — overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $1,000; repeat offender: fine not exceeding $2,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 months or both (enhanced up to 1.5x if in a Liquor Control Zone — s.16)

offence: Drunkenness in public places, etc. (see 14(1) incapable / 14(2) annoyance / 14(4) fail to leave)
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the person is offending in the officer's view (LCSCA s.30 applies to ANY provision of this Act — overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: See 14(1), 14(2) and 14(4); enhanced up to 1.5x if in a Liquor Control Zone (s.16)

offence: Drunk and incapable of taking care of himself or herself in any public place
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the person is offending in the officer's view (LCSCA s.30 applies to ANY provision of this Act — overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $1,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 1 month or both; repeat offender: fine not exceeding $2,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 months or both

offence: Whilst drunk, appears in a public place or trespasses premises and conducts himself or herself so as to cause annoyance to any person
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the person is offending in the officer's view (LCSCA s.30 applies to ANY provision of this Act — overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $1,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 6 months or both; repeat offender: fine not exceeding $2,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 6 months or both

offence: Fails to comply with a direction under s.14(3)(a) to leave the public place or premises
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the person is offending in the officer's view (LCSCA s.30 applies to ANY provision of this Act — overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $1,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 6 months or both; repeat offender: fine not exceeding $2,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 6 months or both

offence: Contravening a Liquor Control Zone banning notice (enter/remain or attempt to, without reasonable excuse)
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the person is offending in the officer's view (LCSCA s.30 applies to ANY provision of this Act — overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $2,500 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 months or both

offence: Knowingly or recklessly providing false or misleading information or document in relation to an application or appeal
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the person is offending in the officer's view (LCSCA s.30 applies to ANY provision of this Act — overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $5,000; repeat offender: fine not exceeding $10,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 months or both

offence: Hinders or obstructs a public officer or auxiliary police officer acting in the discharge of duties under this Act
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the person is offending in the officer's view (LCSCA s.30 applies to ANY provision of this Act — overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $2,500 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 months or both

offence: Committing, attempting or causing an act of vandalism
arrestable: May arrest without warrant (VA s.6 — every offence under this Act is arrestable and non-bailable for CPC purposes)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $2,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 years; and (subject to CPC ss.325(1) and 330(1)) caning 3-8 strokes, except caning is not imposed on a first conviction for delible marking under s.2(a)(i) or for s.2(a)(ii)/(iii) poster/banner-type acts

offence: Fails, refuses or neglects to produce written authority or written consent on demand
arrestable: May arrest without warrant (VA s.6 — every offence under this Act is arrestable and non-bailable for CPC purposes)
bailable: Not bailable (VA s.6 — every offence under the Act)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $500

offence: Penalty for begging (habitual beggar causing annoyance / nuisance in public place)
arrestable: May not arrest without warrant (unless specifically empowered; max 2 years — CPC default)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $3,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 2 years

offence: Escape from lawful custody of welfare home / police under the Act
arrestable: May arrest without warrant (Act provides limited arrest for escape-related situations)
punishment: See Act

offence: Behaving in disorderly manner in welfare home
arrestable: May arrest without warrant (Act provides limited arrest for related situations)
punishment: See Act

offence: Unlicensed moneylending
arrestable: May arrest without warrant (max 4 years — CPC default for other laws)
punishment: 1st offence: fine $30,000-$300,000 and imprisonment up to 4 years and caning up to 6 strokes; subsequent higher

offence: Harassment on behalf of unlicensed moneylender
arrestable: May arrest without warrant (expressly arrestable and non-bailable under MA s.86 — no in-view limit)
punishment: Imprisonment up to 5 years and fine $5,000-$50,000; caning (minimum applies if damage caused)

offence: Unauthorised access to computer material
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if reasonably suspected of committing an offence under this Act (CMA s.19 — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
bailable: Bailable for basic first offence (max 2 years); not bailable if damage caused (max 7 years) — CPC default for other laws
punishment: 1st: fine not exceeding $5,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 2 years or both; subsequent: fine not exceeding $10,000 or 3 years or both; if damage caused: fine not exceeding $50,000 or 7 years or both

offence: Access with intent to commit or facilitate commission of an offence
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if reasonably suspected of committing an offence under this Act (CMA s.19 — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
bailable: Not bailable (max 10 years — CPC default for other laws)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $50,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 10 years or both

offence: Unauthorised modification of computer material
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if reasonably suspected of committing an offence under this Act (CMA s.19 — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
bailable: Not bailable (max 3 years / 5 years subsequent / 7 years if damage — CPC default)
punishment: 1st: fine not exceeding $10,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 years or both; subsequent: fine not exceeding $20,000 or 5 years or both; if damage caused: fine not exceeding $50,000 or 7 years or both

offence: Unauthorised use or interception of computer service
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if reasonably suspected of committing an offence under this Act (CMA s.19 — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
bailable: Not bailable (max 3 years / 5 years subsequent / 7 years if damage — CPC default)
punishment: 1st: fine not exceeding $10,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 years or both; subsequent: fine not exceeding $20,000 or 5 years or both; if damage caused: fine not exceeding $50,000 or 7 years or both

offence: Unauthorised obstruction of use of computer
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if reasonably suspected of committing an offence under this Act (CMA s.19 — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
bailable: Not bailable (max 3 years / 5 years subsequent / 7 years if damage — CPC default)
punishment: 1st: fine not exceeding $10,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 years or both; subsequent: fine not exceeding $20,000 or 5 years or both; if damage caused: fine not exceeding $50,000 or 7 years or both

offence: Unauthorised disclosure of access code
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if reasonably suspected of committing an offence under this Act (CMA s.19 — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
bailable: Not bailable (max 3 years first / 5 years subsequent — CPC default)
punishment: 1st: fine not exceeding $10,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 years or both; subsequent: fine not exceeding $20,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 5 years or both

offence: Supplying, etc., personal information obtained in contravention of certain provisions
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if reasonably suspected of committing an offence under this Act (CMA s.19 — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
bailable: Not bailable (max 3 years first / 5 years subsequent — CPC default)
punishment: 1st: fine not exceeding $10,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 years or both; subsequent: fine not exceeding $20,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 5 years or both

offence: Obtaining or supplying items for use in offences under ss.3-7
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if reasonably suspected of committing an offence under this Act (CMA s.19 — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
bailable: Not bailable (max 3 years first / 5 years subsequent — CPC default)
punishment: 1st: fine not exceeding $10,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 years or both; subsequent: fine not exceeding $20,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 5 years or both
